notes: no wiring eval found referencing this tool_name outside the two design contracts; treat as schema-only until a dedicated wiring task lands

name: (reserved, name not yet assigned)
source_task_id: CLAUDE_TASK_MCP_ORCH_GATED_ENABLEMENT_B106_V1 (deferred, not this task, not created by this task)
notes: launch_queue_contract.py.attempt_start() ALWAYS raises LaunchDisabledError even when both env gates are forced to '1', because LAUNCH_IMPLEMENTED is a Python constant False, not a toggle. No env value in existence today can start a process.

name: planned
notes: task_status_mutation=False; A dispatch request passed all preconditions but no audit entry has been written yet.

name: dispatched_dryrun
notes: task_status_mutation=False; The dispatch plan's audit entry has been appended (decision=launch_planned, launch_enabled=false, launch_implemented=false). Ceiling state actually reachable end-to-end today.

name: worker_review_ready
notes: task_status_mutation=False; The task card's OWN canonical status/worker_status (owned by AITools/taskdb.py) shows review/ready_for_review because a worker independently ran `taskctl review <task_id>`.

name: codex_reviewed
notes: task_status_mutation=False; Codex has read a worker_review_ready task's status/result report and made a finalization decision. Records no new field on the task card itself.

name: blocked
notes: task_status_mutation=False; Any error-taxonomy condition halted progression. Reachable from any other state. Never partially mutates the task card.

name: collision
notes: detected_at_leg=1; Two or more active task cards declare overlapping allowed_writes paths.

name: stale_task
notes: detected_at_leg=4; Cached view of a task card no longer matches the LIVE card when re-checked (TOCTOU race).

name: runner_topic_mismatch
notes: detected_at_leg=1; (runner, topic, action) fails core.check_runner_topic_allowlist.

name: missing_artifact
notes: detected_at_leg=1; A path in read_first/allowed_writes does not exist on disk when preflighted.

name: failed_validation
notes: detected_at_leg=4; A task card's validation command would exit nonzero when run by the worker.

name: claude_cli
notes: runs exactly one claimed task inside allowed_writes, runs validation, calls taskctl review, never finalizes done

name: codex_cli
notes: orchestrator/reviewer/finalizer; a launched Codex WORKER instance must NOT self-review or finalize a task it executed -- separation of duties

name: deepseek_manual
notes: no local process and no API key is ever held by the orchestrator; orchestrator only renders a handoff packet for a human to paste; returns to Codex review like any worker

name: bounded_timeout_seconds_default
notes: value=3600s; applies_to_leg=2; NOT reachable end-to-end today: leg 2 (mcp_to_worker_cli_argv_handoff) is never executed under this or any current contract (TIER_4 has zero implementing code; launch_queue_contract.py.attempt_start() always raises LaunchDisabledError). This protocol specifies the rule for the future TIER_4 gated launch executor; it enforces nothing today.

name: concurrency_cap_default
notes: value=1; at most 1 concurrent gated launch per AIWORKHUB_REPO cwd-pin at any time; over-cap requests are blocked (decision=launch_blocked_precondition_failed) and audited, never silently queued

name: live_enforced_timeout_constant_DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS
notes: value=60s default, env override AIWORKHUB_TIMEOUT; passed as the timeout= kwarg into every core.run_taskctl() child-process call for 'python3 AITools/taskctl.py <args>'; CURRENTLY ENFORCED for every live TIER_1/TIER_2 tool call today, distinct from the not-yet-reachable 3600s bounded_timeout_seconds_default

name: execution_timeout
notes: the future TIER_4 executor kills the child process (SIGTERM then SIGKILL) and records this outcome; supervisor_state transitions dispatched_dryrun -> blocked, mirroring the existing dispatched_dryrun->blocked transition trigger set

name: credential_handling
notes: No code path in this protocol reads credential/secret env values or files. Reuses core.py's existing _sanitize_env_for_audit() pattern: only env var NAMES + set/unset boolean tokens may ever be logged (env_gate_status_tokens()), never values. env_scrub for a future TIER_4 launch passes only PYTHONPATH, AIWORKHUB_REPO, PATH, and allowlisted AIWORKHUB_* flag NAMES; all other env is dropped before any child process would see it.

name: shell_execution_policy
notes: would_run_argv is always an argv LIST, never a shell string; no future launcher may enable shell-mode invocation. command_allowlist restricts the only launchable binaries to 'claude' and 'codex' (deepseek_manual is manual_only, never a local process) plus exactly 7 python3 AITools/taskctl.py subcommands verified verbatim from phase2_orchestration_contract_b104_v1.command_allowlist: auto-pickup, contract, show, review, collision-guard, verify, usage. Anything else is blocked and audited -- no arbitrary command is ever prepared or run.

name: per_project_isolation
notes: cwd is pinned to a single AIWORKHUB_REPO value per request (parameterized repo root, not hardcoded per-tenant path); a launched worker (future TIER_4) would be confined to that one working tree; allowed_writes scoping is enforced by taskctl, not duplicated by the orchestrator

name: daemon_policy
notes: No new long-running process, listener, or background loop. The MCP server remains the existing stdio request/response FastMCP process; this protocol adds no additional daemon and no new server entrypoint.

name: network_policy
notes: Orchestrator opens no new listeners; a future launched worker (TIER_4) would inherit host network only, never a new orchestrator-managed socket/API call.

name: write_gate_policy
notes: AIWORKHUB_ALLOW_WRITES (real, implemented, default '0', gates TIER_2 write tools); AIWORKHUB_ALLOW_LAUNCH (proposed name only, referenced consistently across b02/b104/b118; LAUNCH_IMPLEMENTED remains a Python constant False in launch_queue_contract.py so this flag currently gates nothing that exists)
